name: Saguaro Yoga Club
description: A concept site for an imaginary yoga studio in Scottsdale. A cartoon saguaro does the poses, a mood picker suggests a class, and the schedule opens on today and filters by style. Every cactus is code.

name: El Único Taquería
description: A concept site for an imaginary taquería that sells one taco. Build three tacos al pastor, pour La Única, take a bite of chocoflan, and come back after closing to see the whole place lit in neon. Every drawing is code.

description: This site. Astro, plain CSS, hosted on Vercel.
